ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the picture, from left to right, there are three sofa schematic diagrams. The sofa on the left has 3 equal-width seats, and is marked with a total width of 220 cm; the sofa in the middle has 2 equal-width seats, and is marked with a total width of 160 cm; the sofa on the right has 1 seat, and no width is marked. Armrests are drawn on both the left and right sides of each sofa. Reasoning: Let the width of each seat be s, and the combined width of the left and right armrests be A. According to the 3-person sofa, the total width is A + 3s = 220. According to the 2-person sofa, the total width is A + 2s = 160. Subtracting the two equations gives s = 60. The width of the 1-person sofa is A + s, and A + 2s = 160, so A + s = 160 - 60 = 100. Therefore the 1-person sofa is 100 cm wide.

From the text, use that all seats are equally wide and all armrests are equally wide. Let one seat have width s and the combined two armrests have width A. Then the image/text give A + 3s = 220 and A + 2s = 160. Subtract to get s = 60, then compute the 1-seater width A + s = 160 - 60 = 100 cm.
